note: Hand calculations with stated assumptions (beams, cantilevers, friction and contact models, mesh overlap tests on the real geometry), written by the designer and challenged by four independent reviewers. Not FEA and not lab tests: the physical tests below are what settles them.
assumptions: Load cases: 3 g handling, 10 g action, 15 g sideways, 30 g crash, on the 161 g camera + pod. Limits: 1/3 of strength at 10 g, below ultimate at 30 g.
Friction is modelled, not fudged: lead-in force = flex force x cot(ramp - friction angle) at friction 0.4; fins checked for jamming up to friction 1.0.
Constant stress in PLA (preload) kept at or below 5 MPa against creep.
Unknown camera dimensions each have one parameter (hole depth, rim thickness, slot position, shutter position, lens position, camera height); the base-only fit print answers them.
pod: rigid block from make_cage.make_pod(), 161 g, centre of mass at mid-height (24 mm) and x = +2 (camera side).
PLA E 3500 MPa (PETG 2000), 50 MPa along layers / 20 MPa across layers, design limit 1/3 of that at 10 g.
TPU 95A E 26 MPa (printed TPU varies; fin forces are also given for 0.5x and 2x).
bar: beam from the hinge pin to the snap, section properties from slices of the real bar mesh.
end frames: two posts as cantilevers from the base top (rail, block and plate ignored: conservative).
